entities.name: Olivia Różański
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Olivia Różański  is a French-born Polish professional indoor volleyball player who plays as an Outside Hitter. She has won bronze medal at the 2023 FIVB Volleyball Women's Nations League with the Poland women's national volleyball team and she is the daughter of the former volleyball player Jarosława Różańska.
